prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your new desktop pet is officially adopted and ready to join your screen.", "Official Adoption Seal"]
1: ["Initializing Desktop Pet Overlay...", "Setting up desktop engine and rendering your pet companion."]
2: ["Protect Your Pet & Save Progress", "Sign in to securely store your pet's memory, items, and settings so your companion is never lost when relaunching."]
3: ["Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop!", "Your pet is now live. Learn the quick desktop controls to interact, move, or hide your pet anytime.", "Click pet to interact | Right-click for menu | Drag to move"]
4: ["Choose How You Want to Adopt", "Pick an instant starter companion or create a custom pet from scratch.", "Instant Starter Pet vs Custom AI Pet"]
5: ["Quick Desktop Controls Guide", "Here is how to interact with your pet on your desktop at any time.", "Got It!"]
6: ["Run Photo Quality Check", "Ensure good lighting and single-subject focus for best results."]
7: ["Signing in connects your pet to your account so you can restore your pet anytime on any device."]
8: ["Loading desktop window renderer... Your pet will pop up on screen in just a moment."]
9: []
